  "final_claim": "Aggregate volume effect is uncertain (p=0.75, wide CI). For creators, token-level persistence is supported by RPC pool activity (99%+ 30d active) and Moralis decoded sample (57k swaps, 294 tokens). For retail fairness, high-concentration tokens show 52.4 pp higher risk. For security, RPC mechanism validates operational migration. For UX, community sentiment and TVL panels are available but not causally identified. For community, Discord sentiment panel exists but no causal estimate. Overall, the regime shows operational success but causal welfare gains are not cleanly identified."
